N° 08IT service management2026

Uplink ServiceOps Console

Calm service operations, from the first ticket to the last.

This one is a private build for now. Ask me for a walkthrough.How to use itWatch the purpose

I

Purpose

A console a technician would want on a Monday: tickets, assets, projects and network operations in one quiet interface, with one search across everything.

II

The problem

Ticket systems bury the technician under fields, asset databases drift, and network state lives in a separate tool with a separate login.

III

What I built

Status coded workflows, a search that spans every record, responsive layouts for a phone in a server room, light and dark themes, and a personal practice lab for every new account.

IV

How it works

A custom design system and a single database for every module. Private for now, paused while the academy grows.

V

Craft

Forest and ivory, and a sign in page that says what the product is before asking who you are.

VI

The purpose, in motion

A short motion design made for this book: four beats, one drawn shape each, the reason the project exists. Tap it to step through.

Uplink ServiceOps Console
VII

In short

  • Tickets, assets, projects, network in one
  • Global search across records
  • Practice lab on first sign in
  • Light and dark
